description:
Look up any company across 195+ countries using data sourced directly from official government registries.

What you can do:

Find company registration details, status, and filings
Pull financial statements and key figures
Identify directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners
Map corporate group structures and ownership chains
Verify businesses for KYB and compliance checks

Global Database connects to 400+ government registries worldwide, covering 600M+ companies. Every data point traces back to an official source.

defaultPrompt: Look up Stripe and show its profile, financials and ownership
Run a KYB check on Revolut - registry record, directors and shareholders
Find SaaS companies in Germany with 50-200 employees and over 10M EUR revenue
